body:
The history of this seems to be something along the lines of this:

#114236 changed the positioning of `PopupMenu` submenus (in `PopupMenu::_activate_submenu`) to be offset from `scroll_container` instead of `panel`, with (what I'm guessing was) the intention of shifting everything down when the search bar is enabled. This introduced a regression for the case where submenus need to be opened in the other direction (and likely RTL as well) as `*_offset_end` would (as best I can understand it) represent the flipped right/top edge within its parent container's space (?) as opposed to the popup's edge within its container, which in the case of `scroll_container` is `vbox_container`, leading to the submenu being offset too far to the left.

#118014 then reverted that change to fix said regression, which means that submenu positioning is now offset from `panel` again, but with no consideration of the search bar at all, meaning submenus are positioned too high up when the search bar is enabled.
